answer:
Only one San Francisco mobile option fits your job:

**Cormorant Mobile Detailing — 415-555-0142**
Mobile, serves your ZIP, and its exterior wash (The Skiff) is outside-only — foam hand wash, wheels/tires, door jambs, outside glass, hand dry, nothing inside.

How your request maps:
- “come to us in SoMa 94103” = its no-travel-fee SF zone, includes 94103
- “wash the outsides, nothing inside” = The Skiff exterior wash
- “3 Ford Transit vans” = oversized Class D — full-size van like Ford Transit. $139 each before fees/tax. 3+ vehicles at one address/one day = fleet job.
- “Saturday” = open, morning window 8:00-9:30 only, + $25 Saturday fee. Next open Saturdays listed: Nov 7 morning and Nov 21 morning.

The Saturday conflict you need to know:
Fleet jobs (3-4 vehicles = 10% off service price) run **Tuesday to Friday only**. So a 3-van Saturday cannot get the fleet discount on its stated rules — it would be full price + Saturday fee. No power needed for exterior-only, but 3+ vehicles needs a working spigot within 100 ft, plus space legal for the whole job with 3 ft clear both sides and room for their 20-ft work van within 100 ft.

All-in totals (no add-ons, no contamination surcharge, no travel fee):

- **Saturday (no fleet discount allowed): 3 x $139 = $417 + $25 Saturday fee = $442 + 8.625% tax = $480.12 all-in.** $50 deposit to book, counts toward total.
- For comparison, same 3 washes on Tue-Fri as a fleet job: $417 less 10% = $375.30 + 8.625% tax = $407.67 all-in, one travel fee per visit ($0 in 94103).

Others ruled out:
- Peninsula Suds Mobile Wash — Peninsula only, “Not serving San Francisco at this time”
- Sunset Shine Auto Spa — drop your car off at shop, not mobile
- Ferry Point Auto Care — partner parking garages only, not to-your-lot

To book, you’ll request via their form and owner Ines replies by text/email within 4 business hours (Mon-Sat 8am-6pm), then pay deposit link within 12 hours to hold slot. Needs 24-hours notice. 3 exterior washes take ~1-1.5 hrs each.

If Saturday is firm, confirm with them that they will do 3 vans on Saturday at full price despite the “fleet Tue-Fri only” rule before paying deposit — that rule could also mean they’ll ask you to split to a weekday.
